newsitem.title: USA: St. Paul sees more industry consolidation.
newsitem.headline: St. Paul sees more industry consolidation.

text.p: St. Paul Cos Inc chief executive Douglas Leatherdale said he expects the size and number of insurance industry consolidations and restructurings to intensify because of tough market conditions.

"With more and more capital chasing fewer premium dollars, the consolidations and restructurings that have become a part of daily life in this business will not just continue -- they will intensify in both size and number," Leatherdale said in the company's 1996 annual report.
St. Paul, he said, is in an "ideal position" to take advantage of these market conditions.
He said St. Paul will use its capital strength to purposefully expand its operations.
"We will continue to carefully acquire companies that will increase our capacity and expertise," he said in the annual report.

"We will pursue expansion opportunities in selected international markets. And you can expect that we will take advantage of opportunities to expand our presence in the reinsurance marketplace," he said.
